finalText: Migration finished. All 12 application call sites (`support`, `orders`, `catalog`, `billing`, `analytics`, `accounts` packages) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. The only remaining `db.query` usage is in `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which is intentionally left alone — it's a vendored dependency ("replaced wholesale on every upgrade, local changes are silently lost"), and `lib/db.js` still exposes `db.query` as a deprecated shim precisely to keep that vendored code working until it's upgraded upstream.
